recommendation.entitySemantics: Per-owner encounter entities, preserving existing capture rules; global counter still shared across all live owners of the same templateId
recommendation.encoding: Canonical tuple/opaque registry key owned by08; never ambiguous string concatenation and never derive from device/session/actionId/permit retry/position refresh
recommendation.allocationPoint: First opened actual target encounter after original verified location/range checks, before its globalSerial is shown. Nearby map candidates remain unallocated placeholders.
recommendation.lightweightEntry: Future discovery observe endpoint validates server-generated target and signed discovery proof; does not start a battle or grant capture/XP/seeds
recommendation.reserveCompatibility: Reuse the same registered entity; legacy clients may ensure it at reserve. Original stable entity registration survives new permit UUID, cancel/retry/restart.
recommendation.capture: Within the existing capture transaction bind the same wild entity/serial to the original owner+petId.08 owned allocator must recognize this binding and skip increment.
recommendation.expiry: Old entity numbers never recycled; new hourly/catalog generation is a different candidate, not a renumbering of old captured/permit history
recommendation.qa: Explicit server scenario namespace;08 determines counter namespace. Do not infer QA from nickname or alter historical owners.

alternativeNotImplicitlyAuthorized.globalSharedSpawn: If the same spawn is one global animal for all owners, a global single-capture claim is required. Otherwise two different owned pets would inherit one public number. This changes existing multiplayer capture semantics and needs root decision.
alternativeNotImplicitlyAuthorized.batchNearbyAllocation: If every map candidate must already show a real number, ensure all returned new entities before nearby response and accept that scanning multiple same-type candidates consumes their numbers. Do not promise B0003 after a whole unobserved batch.
